Introduction:

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse is a trial court in Marion County, Alabama. It was constructed in 1901 and rebuilt in 1959. It has jurisdiction over cases of criminal, traffic and vehicle matters. This court also handles speeding ticket matters given by sheriffs and police on different highways. Proper Dressing and mask are required during the case hearing and court visit. The court schedule for trials and other things are available online on the website.

How to find records information?

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse record information for cases are available in the town clerk's and county clerk's offices and found online on different websites. All the case information and trails are recorded and maintained by the county and clerk's office. They can be searched online by using the following ways:

  • Searching by case number
  • Searching by name and city/state
  • Searching by address
  • Searching by phone
  • Searching by email

Sometimes, case information records are unavailable online because it is confidential according to the law, like criminal cases, etc. These types of information are only available at the county court or county clerk's office. They can be obtained by filing and sending a record request form. Fill in all the required information on the form. Send the fees for the copies of the record. After receiving the form, the court will respond with whether to provide this information. For more information about the public records, call or mail the court.

How to make payments?

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse payments for tickets and fines can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can pay for tickets and fines by visiting the court during regular court hours and paying in cash, checks, or with a card at the counter. Take your ticket when you are coming for payment. 2.99% processing and other charges will be applied if you make payment with a credit card. Credit and debit card payments are accepted at the city hall.

Online

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse online payment can be made using the court Online Payment Portal https://hamiltonal.govtportal.com/. Enter the case or ticket number and valid credit card information. The service fees will be applied in this case.

Mail

A Person can send a certified check or money order to the court's Violation Bureau mailing address, PO Box 188 Hamilton, AL 35570. Cash or personal checks are not acceptable in the mail; only certified checks or money orders are accepted. Remember to write your citation when you send the payment, and mail the amount in a self-addressed, stamped envelope if you want a receipt.

Phone

Payment can also be made by calling 205-920-2354 during working hours. Service charges are applied in this method.

How to make online payments?

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse online payment can be made in three ways by using the online portal https://hamiltonal.govtportal.com/. You can pay by clicking on the pay here method, typing the case or ticket number, and selecting the payment method. The second way to pay is by calling and following the steps the person describes. A third way is to pay with the voice portal. In all three methods, the service fee is applied.

How many fees do you have to pay for a traffic violation?

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse fees for the violation of traffic and vehicles depend upon the type of violation a person has committed. $198 for driving with a speed of 25 and over it, $188 if stopping on the highway, $178 if driving on the wrong side of the road and the following someone very closely, $183 for improper tagging, $178 for improper backing and improper turn, $41 if do not wear seatbelts and 238 if drives without a license.

How can I send a plea by mail?

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse plea can only be written if you received a traffic infraction, vehicle, speeding, or parking ticket. Write a plea and send it before the citation date written on your ticket. Download the plea form, choose the plea you want, write your name and email address date, and sign your signature. Two types of plea can be written and mailed to the court that are:

Plea of Guilty

Choose a guilty plea if you admit you violated the law or committed a crime. The court will review your application and respond with the fine amount or, in severe cases, with a court date. You can choose a Driving School Course in this plea.

Plea of Not Guilty

If you do not accept your offense and deny all the violations against you, then choose the plea of not guilty. The court will review your application and send you a schedule for your court appearance, and you have to appear on time. Firstly a trial date is given to you, and you must appear with all the proof in your defense. Hire an attorney in this case. You cannot choose a Driving School Course in this plea.

Which courses are offered by the driving school?

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse driving school offers a defensive driving course, online TX adult drivers ED, ticket dismissal course, 4-Hours TLSAE Drugs and Alcohol Course and many more. You can explore and select the type, of course, that is eligible for you. Your traffic ticket can be dismissed when you complete the course and pay the fees on time. You have to submit all the documents if you are eligible for the driving school, and then the schedule for the course will be given to you.

In which cases is appearing in court compulsory?

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse court appearance is necessary in an accident, personal injury, hit and run case, criminal case and when you write a plea of not guilty. The traffic violation cases list in which appearance is not necessary is available on the website. Your appearance is compulsory if your violation and case are unavailable on that list.

Architectural Features of the Courthouse

The Hamilton Alabama Courthouse is a beautiful building that features many architectural details that are unique to the time period in which it was built. The building is constructed in the Romanesque Revival style, which was popular in the late 19th century. The courthouse features a clock tower with four clock faces and a bell that still chimes on the hour. The building also has a large central dome that is surrounded by smaller domes on each corner. The courthouse's red brick exterior is complemented by sandstone accents, which add to its overall beauty.

Hamilton Alabama Courthouse Today

Today, the Hamilton Alabama Courthouse is a popular tourist attraction that draws visitors from all over the country. The courthouse is open to the public and offers guided tours of the building's interior. Visitors can learn about the history of the courthouse and the role it played in the development of the town. The courthouse also hosts many community events throughout the year, including festivals, concerts, and other cultural events.

FAQ:

How much fine do I have to pay if I drive without a helmet?

You had to pay $178 if you drove without a helmet.

What happens if I fail to appear in court?

If you do not appear on the schedule and do not pay the ticket or fine on time, additional charges will be applied, your driving license or insurance will be suspended, and in some cases, a warrant against you will be issued.
